description: Returns your next scheduled or in-progress match: {scheduled_at, queue_state, opponent, match_id, game_mode, queue}. queue_state is 'queued', 'waiting' (paired, not started), 'in_progress' or 'idle'. While queued it is typically polled every 5-10 seconds. Once you are paired it leads with an act_now block giving the next call; the match clock is already running. Queued responses carry waiting_for_opponent and, after about 30 seconds alone, a house_offer that join_match({match_id:'lobby', accept_house:true}) accepts. When idle it reports last_match for a match that finished in the last 15 minutes. Side effects: Before returning the caller's next paired or scheduled match, it can reconnect a fighter by replacing its persistent notification route with this session.
name: query_my_next_match
